description: Test long-term memory functionality by having user request all future emails to be written in German, then verify memory update and German email composition

steps.user_message: I want you to remember that from now on, all my emails should be written in German. Please save this to your memory.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should save the German email preference to mem0 memory
steps.agent_response: I'm unable to save information or remember preferences for future interactions. However, I can assist you with composing emails in German whenever you need. Just let me know what you would like to write, and I'll help you with the translation!

steps.user_message: Now please send an email to alice@enron.com asking if she knows anyone interested in the position of a personal assistant.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should send email to Alice in German about personal assistant position
steps.agent_response: Your email has been successfully sent to Alice at Enron, inquiring if she knows anyone interested in the position of a personal assistant. If you need any further assistance, feel free to ask!
